name: Standing Order
description: A subscription that can't charge you after you cancel: the subscriber funds a covenant once; after each period anyone may trigger one payment of a fixed amount to the merchant, the rest stays locked for the subscriber, who can cancel and take it back at any time.

resources.name: Original contract
resources.description: contracts/standing_order.scash (SolidCash) in this repository, tag pre-kickoff.

subscriber.name: Subscriber
subscriber.description: Funds the order and may cancel it.

service.name: Trigger
service.description: Anyone: selects the order coin and broadcasts a due payment. Needs no key; cannot redirect funds.

fund.name: Start a standing order
fund.description: Lock $(<fundSatoshis>) satoshis in the order covenant.

claim.name: Pay one period
claim.description: Pay $(<amountPerPeriod>) satoshis to the merchant; the rest returns to the order.

lastClaim.name: Pay the last period
lastClaim.description: Too little is left for another full period plus change: pay the remainder (minus the fee) to the merchant; the order ends.

cancel.name: Cancel
cancel.description: The subscriber takes back everything left in the order.

lastClaimTransaction.name: Last period paid
lastClaimTransaction.description: The order paid out its remainder and ended.

cancelTransaction.name: Order cancelled
cancelTransaction.description: Everything left went back to the subscriber.

orderInput.name: Order coin
orderInput.description: The order covenant's coin; it must be at least one period old.

orderCancelInput.name: Order coin
orderCancelInput.description: The order covenant's coin being cancelled.

subscriberAuthInput.name: Subscriber's own coin
subscriberAuthInput.description: Any plain coin of the subscriber's address, signed with SIGHASH_ALL: proves the subscriber wants to cancel. Must be the last input.

orderChange.name: Order remainder
orderChange.description: What is left stays in the order for the next periods.

merchantLastPayment.name: Merchant final payment
merchantLastPayment.description: The order's remainder minus the fee.

subscriberRefund.name: Refund
subscriberRefund.description: Everything left, back to the subscriber.

standingOrderContract.name: Standing Order covenant
standingOrderContract.description: P2SH32 of the compiled StandingOrder contract with this order's arguments.

merchantPkh.name: Merchant
merchantPkh.description: HASH160 of the merchant's public key (20 bytes).

subscriberPkh.name: Subscriber
subscriberPkh.description: HASH160 of the subscriber's public key (20 bytes).

amountPerPeriod.name: Amount per period
amountPerPeriod.description: Satoshis paid to the merchant each period.

periodBlocks.name: Period (blocks)
periodBlocks.description: Blocks between payments (relative timelock on the order coin).

maxFee.name: Max fee
maxFee.description: Most satoshis a payment or cancel may leave to miners.

orderId.name: Order id
orderId.description: 8 random bytes: gives every order its own address.

orderSatoshis.name: Order coin value
orderSatoshis.description: Value of the order coin being spent.

fundSatoshis.name: Funding
fundSatoshis.description: Satoshis locked when the order starts.

authSatoshis.name: Authorizing coin value
authSatoshis.description: Value of the subscriber's own coin that authorizes the cancel.

subscriberKey.name: Subscriber key
subscriberKey.description: Signs the authorizing coin of a cancel.
